## Verification

List checks run and their results. Include CI evidence for the current head,
any skipped or blocked checks, and remaining limitations.

## Completion checklist

- [ ] Issue references reflect the completed scope; unfinished work is identified.
- [ ] Automated review and independent review are complete; findings are resolved.
- [ ] Checks pass on the current head before merge.
